narr: Heavy rain associated with a low pressure system fell across much of the Ohio Valley.
ev: A swift water rescue occurred on Brush Fork Creek when a vehicle was trapped by rushing water.
Water was flowing over E County Rd 1300 N.
Indiana 62 was closed near Friendship due to high water from Laughery Creek.
